functions.contract: Count piece codes 1 through 4 across 49 cells and write four trailing counters.

functions.name: cell_begin_forward_move_iteration

functions.name: cell_begin_reverse_move_iteration

functions.contract: Enumerate unique adjacent clone destinations, then distance-two jumps.

functions.contract: Enumerate clones and jumps while marking yielded destinations in the iterator board.

functions.name: cell_next_reverse_move
functions.contract: Enumerate empty destinations, one adjacent clone source, then friendly distance-two jump sources.

functions.name: cell_apply_move_to_scratch_board
functions.contract: Copy 49 cells and four counters, apply the move, and convert occupied adjacent cells.

functions.name: cell_score_candidate_move
functions.contract: Evaluate simulated piece-count changes with a signed byte score and root-move clone bias.

functions.name: cell_count_adjacent_clone_opportunities

functions.name: cell_append_tied_best_move

functions.name: cell_choose_best_move

functions.name: cell_search_recursive

functions.name: cell_search_best_move

functions.name: cell_reset_ranked_move_list

functions.name: cell_insert_ranked_move
functions.contract: Insert the current move and byte score into a descending linked list with FFFF sentinel.

functions.name: cell_build_ranked_move_list
functions.contract: Override the supplied depth with one, enumerate moves, and build the ranked list.

functions.name: cell_search_ranked_moves
functions.contract: Evaluate the ranked list with recursive search, accumulate ties, and select a move.

functions.name: cell_run_grv_puzzle_search
